authority.current_deliverable: freeze one matched temporal-score Q/QM design and integrate actual learner/evaluation/independent audit using generated arrays only

estimand: Numerical support impedance increment above frozen Q15 plus shared missingness/order under one common temporal-centered score; not all metadata versus no metadata, joint retraining, or deployment selection

cohort_plan.evidence_scope: repeatedly exposed source39 development, not independent confirmation
cohort_plan.fold_assignment: sorted participant ID rank modulo 3, rebuilt within each outer training partition

features.q: support-only 15 features, same equations as support_q but new mask-only API; numerical M must not be passed
features.m: support-prefix channel-centered observed mean and population SD of log1p(impedance_kohm); observed zero valid
features.q2: Q feature indices [1,2]: log off-reference power fraction and repeat disagreement
features.scaling: fit-partition-only per-feature population mean/SD; SD<1e-12 replaced by 1; no clipping; unavailable M/Q2 residual inputs zero after scaling
features.m_scaler: fit on available rows only, common for correct/sham donor permutation within that partition
features.empty_available_fit_rows: both M and Q2 scalers mean0 SD1 and coefficients0; all200 masked steps have zero residual gradient; record structural absence and exact Q without replacing missing values by observed zeros
features.numeric_missing_fallback: exact frozen Q; keep shared original missingness mask

operator.s_c: unchanged native trca_matrices, no new trialwise centering
operator.r: 8*softmax(q_logits + residual_logits), along channels; Q has zero residual
operator.tau: eta*lambda_min(C)/(16/9), per support class/band, identical across positive-mass arms and independent of actual R or numerical M
operator.bound: C <= B <= 1.1*C in Loewner order; no accuracy/angle guarantee
operator.sign_anchor: NONE for positive-mass arms; store native W only for separate FULL controls
operator.eigen_backward: custom leading-projector backward; lower eigenvalue multiplicities allowed, top gap required
operator.native_zero_path: FULL_NATIVE: exact unchanged gamma0 fit/score. FULL_CENTERED: SAME native gamma0 filters/templates with new temporal scorer, no refit or renormalization. Positive-path zerohead=ISO, not FULL.
operator.invalid_policy: fail entire attempt with preserved receipt; no hidden jitter, pseudo-inverse, dropped participant, alternate candidate or numerical M fallback
operator.projector: L=chol(B), H=L^-1SL^-T, K=L^-T Ptop(H) L^-1, F=K/tr(CK)
operator.temporal_statistics: positive pertrial/band scaling, subtract first sample then temporal mean perchannel; discard mean terms only in newscore; no S/C/Q refit

learner.sharing: one global head per outer fit, shared across interfaces/windows/budgets/bands/channels; class blind
learner.stage_1: fit Q using source block5 classification CE
learner.stage_2: freeze Q and fit separate Q2, QM and SHAM residuals on the same source-training block5 labels
learner.not_claimed: OOF orthogonal residual estimation, faithful-heteroscedastic guarantee or M-optimal lambda; support labels still create class-aligned features/S/templates, while class IDs are not head inputs
learner.score: signed linear sum of component-time-centered ensemble Pearson, identical for ISO/Q/Q2/QM/SHAM/PERMUTED/STALE/MISSING
learner.loss_weighting: equal participants, 8 interface/window conditions, 2 budgets and 12 class queries
learner.regularizer: lambda*mean(square(all currently trainable coefficients including bias))
learner.selection: minimum participant-mean inner-validation Q CE only; within 1e-12 tie choose larger lambda; all residual pipelines recomputed inside each inner-fit partition for each candidate, never used to choose lambda
learner.final_refit: selected common lambda, all outer26; refit scaler/Q then freeze Q and fit three residuals
learner.batch: full-batch gradient or mathematically equivalent fixed-order accumulation before one optimizer step
learner.initialization: all trainable parameters exactly zero, no seed search

controls.sham_donors: sorted-ID next-person cyclic map inside each fit/validation/evaluation partition, interface, order and exact k-prefix missingness stratum
controls.sham_refit: separate residual trained and evaluated on its partition-local donor M; Q and Q scaler frozen
controls.permuted: correct-M-trained QM head receives partition-local donor M at inference; no refit
controls.stale: first support packet repeated k times; original Q and shared mask retained; newly absent M channel has zero residual
controls.missing: deny all numerical M and return exact frozen Q
controls.coverage: k3 feature-change >1e-12 in either M feature, participant/interface units 78; singleton and unchanged feature cases remain in denominator
controls.q2_matching_limit: 3-parameter bounded residual and optimization budget matched, not complete EEG-information sufficiency
controls.full_native: unchanged native gamma0 baseline; original practical noninferiority guard stays bound to this arm
controls.full_centered: exact same gamma0 W/templates with new score; paireddiagnostic and additional practical noninferiority guard, never selected instead of FULL_NATIVE
controls.a0: separate immutable native k0 reference, not recentered/refitted
controls.actuation: R -> perclassF -> J=sumclassF -> score -> argmax; filter motion alone is not utility, same argmax not structural dormancy

decision.primary: participant mean across all 8 conditions of QM3-Q3, percentage points
decision.ci: descriptive paired t interval over 39 participant means, df38; overlapping training folds and adaptive history preclude confirmatory interpretation
decision.grid_attainment: at least 39 correct of 48; zero-budget A0 shared; costs 0/36/60 labels; nonattainment stays null
decision.all_reports: integer counts, participant help/tie/harm/worst loss,312cells, allconditions/k5/NLL, FULL_CENTERED−FULL_NATIVE diagnostic, R/F/J/score/argmax actuation, CPU/CUDA/resources
decision.structural_no_actuation: a valid predefined mapping has identically no residual dependence; no argmax changes alone is NOT structural no-actuation
